name: od_hp_change
description: Overdrive hook on every hit (pp_BtlOdOnHpChange): Stoic, Comrade, Healer, Warrior with its gate and cap, and the aeon mode taking and dealing damage.

harness.note: the real machine code of the functions; only the battle RNG function is replaced by a script (rngDraws is what the game asked for)

notes: in.fn names the kernel function; in.args are its arguments (chr ids, amounts).

in.slots rows are [mode, gauge, gaugeMax, maxHp, hp, refDamage, inBattle, getsTurns, dead, stoned, autoB, extra, buffs, perm, sleep, silence, darkness, slow, eventFlags, apBlocked, afterOn, afterFlag, energyDelta0, energyDelta1, odDelta0, odDelta1, energy, str, mag, mp, mpUsed, odUsed, savedGauge, savedFlag], trailing zeros left out; a slot that is not listed is all zero. in.factor is the float at Chr+0x70c (1.0 when missing).

in.save: counters is {mode: value} (modes not listed are 0), learned is the learned-mode bitmask, levelA/levelB the two level bytes, stat the four statistic counters. in.rom is [a, b, c, cap] of the ply_rom row.
in.g: disabled (0x112a916), mode (0x112c9e5), learned (0x112c02b), grandSummon (0x112ca03), tidusUses (0x113083c), tidusWord (0x11307fc), learnId (0x112c94a), ap {id: total} (0x2310f20).

out holds ret (the function result, when it has one) and ONLY what changed: slots {id: {gauge, eventFlags, apFactor, refDamage, mp, mpUsed, odUsed, savedGauge, savedFlag}}, save {id: {counters {mode: value}, stat {index: value}}}, ap {id: total}, learned, g, and energy for the after-action function.
